carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible; the primary ridge in the upper third of the flank exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense aggregation of small, high-luminance points is localized on the dorsal-anterior surface of the head, distinct from the larger, more spaced patterning on the flank.
